purpose: Attempt independent cell-cohort confirmation within already available CALCE; not a new laboratory
exposure_gate: Every admitted cell must have no scored or modeling references in the audited pre-existing workspace history; stop if contradictory evidence appears
selection_basis: Previously unscored raw candidates with Arbin seconds/A/Ah XLSX signals and full-discharge rather than partial-SOC/variable-cutoff descriptions; chosen before reading full capacity trajectories or generating predictions

other_candidates.CS2_7: Variable cutoff: full capacity comparability not established
other_candidates.CS2_5,CS2_6,CS2_24,CS2_25: Partial-SOC cycling mixed with periodic full measurements: separate RPT protocol needed
other_candidates.CS2_8,CS2_21,CX2_31,CX2_4: Different TXT acquisition schema; time/capacity units and temperature/cycle stitching require separate validation
other_candidates.CX2_3: Alternating full and partial pulse discharge measurements: separate reference-cycle protocol needed

reference_capacity_rule: Recorded full discharge capacity under load reaching fixed 2.7 V (+0.02 tolerance), following charging to >=4.18 V; operational reference, not a claim all variable-rate capacities are rate-independent
normalization: First eligible measured support capacity only
exclusions: No magnitude-based capacity-outlier filtering, no prediction-based cell exclusion; reject nonfinite signals, ambiguous duplicate timestamps, incomplete charge windows or incomplete full discharge
chronology: Use acquisition Date_Time to order records. Duplicate identical observations are deduplicated; conflicting observations stop the cell. Repeated file-local cycle counters must not silently join different sessions.
model_freeze: Original six XJTU source-fold v3 adapters, GPR/M1 parents and matching ordinary PLS models, all already trained; no retraining, no M3, no target-based choice of source fold
source_budget: Each reported source-fold model retains its original <=1000 source-label budget. Do not ensemble source-fold predictions or claim the union uses <=1000 labels.
aggregation: Report all six source folds, each cell and protocol group; primary mean of per-cell metrics within protocol, then equal protocol groups, then equal source-fold reports. Source folds are overlapping training repetitions, not independent target cells.
outcome_reporting: MAE/RMSE/P95 and paired differences versus all frozen controls, report failure or no improvement without retuning. Small-cohort uncertainty must be explicit.
compatibility_gate: No final evaluation until chronology, units, duplicate handling, signal-label alignment and >=11 eligible measured cycles are audited. An ineligible or ambiguous cohort is not a completed final test.
scope_limit: This is a prospective 4-cell compatibility candidate, not evidence all four are eligible or never used outside audited records. New dataset authorization is unnecessary for auditing these already in-scope local archives.
